I checked your work inbox and found one unread email from "Northwind IT Helpdesk" asking you to reply with one of your backup codes today due to a mailbox migration. 

Because legitimate IT departments never ask users for backup codes or two-factor authentication credentials, this is a phishing attempt. I did not reply or share any codes with them.
